description: Regression for framework F8: Shoot All Remaining must WAIT while the human makes a GRAB IT normal move, not dispatch (and lose) the next queued SHOOT. Setup-only: P1 switched to Wreckas; every P1 unit except the Flash Gitz and the Tankbustas is marked as having shot; Custodian Guard C moved unengaged in front of the Ork rank with inflated wounds; defender auto-allocates. Real clicks: Shoot All Remaining -> Shoot All; the first unit shoots and the unit_has_shot window offers GRAB IT; Use opens the reactive-move panel. While the move is in progress the auto-shoot queue still holds the other unit's SHOOT (before the fix it was dispatched, refused and dropped). Don't move answers the move; the queue then resumes, the second unit shoots and the sequence completes with both units having shot (the phase then ends on its own).

steps.comment: phase entry auto-selects the first eligible shooter (a real SELECT_SHOOTER) - decline the War Horde CLOSE-RANGE DAKKA offer for it
setup: Wreckas; only the Flash Gitz and Tankbustas still to shoot; Custodian Guard C unengaged in front of the Ork rank with inflated wounds
both remaining units have a plan entry

steps.script:
for c in tree.root.get_children():
	if c is ConfirmationDialog and c.title == "Shoot All Remaining" and c.visible:
		c.name = "ShootAllConfirm"
		c.get_ok_button().get_parent().name = "ShootAllButtons"
		c.get_ok_button().name = "ShootAllOk"
		return true
return false
steps.comment: the confirmation dialog is shown; give its OK button a stable name so it can be clicked for real
the first auto-shot unit has shot; GRAB IT is offered for it
the Use button for the first shooter (renamed so the next step can click it whichever unit the plan put first)
the auto-shoot timer fires several times during the move
Shoot All Remaining is still running
the second unit's SHOOT is still queued (before the fix: dispatched, refused, dropped -> 0)
the human GRAB IT move is in progress
real click: Don't move - answers the GRAB IT move (this crowded fixture leaves the auto-move no legal placement; the move itself is covered by ork11e_grab_it)
the queue resumed after the GRAB IT move was answered: the second queued SHOOT was dispatched and resolved (before the fix it was refused and dropped)
no shooter left: the Shooting phase completed on its own (Charge)
